scope: offline guardrail and agent-trajectory regression expansion

backend_unittest.command: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

added_guardrail_coverage: output-side identity-number leakage without raw evidence echo
added_agent_trajectory_coverage: orphan tool result without a corresponding action
tainted tool result propagated to the final Agent output

defect_and_fix.defect: Guardrail evidence excerpts could echo a raw identity number even when the verdict required review.
defect_and_fix.fix: Rule, SingGuard and MLLM evidence excerpts now redact Chinese identity numbers, mainland mobile numbers and common API key or access-token forms.
defect_and_fix.regression_assertion: The output-side personal-data case must contain the personal_data category and must not contain the original identity number.

limitations: These deterministic regression cases validate configured policies and response contracts; they do not establish real-world accuracy, recall or false-positive rates.
Promptfoo exercised the local deployed evaluation gateway and did not benchmark the optional GPU or NPU model backends in this run.
Real human labeling remains 0/20 for the pilot and 0/200 for the full validation set.
A final competition seal must be rerun after real reviewers finish labeling and the final production commit is deployed.
